name: home-apps
description: Trois applications web auto-hébergées pour le foyer : TV Time (séries et films), Sport (entraînement) et Apprendre (langues, parcours façon Duolingo).

scripts.install:all: npm run install:tvtime && npm run install:sport && npm run install:learn
scripts.install:tvtime: npm install --prefix apps/tvtime/server && npm install --prefix apps/tvtime/web
scripts.install:sport: npm install --prefix apps/sport/server && npm install --prefix apps/sport/web
scripts.install:learn: npm install --prefix apps/learn/server && npm install --prefix apps/learn/web
scripts.build: npm run build:tvtime && npm run build:sport && npm run build:learn
scripts.start: concurrently -n tvtime,sport,learn -c yellow,red,green "npm run start:tvtime" "npm run start:sport" "npm run start:learn"
scripts.dev:tvtime: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix apps/tvtime/server" "npm run dev --prefix apps/tvtime/web"
scripts.dev:sport: concurrently -n api,web -c red,cyan "npm run dev --prefix apps/sport/server" "npm run dev --prefix apps/sport/web"
scripts.dev:learn: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix apps/learn/server" "npm run dev --prefix apps/learn/web"
